claim: Domaine Sérol in Renaison offers free tastings without appointment Monday-Saturday 9am-12pm and 2pm-7pm, closed Sundays and holidays.
quote: Tastings are complimentary for individuals and small groups, no appointment necessary. Monday to Saturday from 9:00 am to 12:00 pm and from 2:00 pm to 7:00 pm

claim: Domaine Sérol produces biodynamic Gamay Saint Romain reds on the Côte Roannaise with views over the Roanne plain.
quote: Domaine Sérol produces biodynamic wines on the Côte Roannaise, mainly red wines from the local grape variety Gamay Saint Romain

claim: Domaine des Pothiers in Villemontais opens weekdays 9am-12pm and 1pm-5pm, with Saturday visits by appointment only; tastings €5 for groups.
quote: Opening hours are Monday through Friday between 9 am and 12 pm and between 1 pm and 5 pm, closed on Sundays. Saturday visits are by appointment, with a maximum group size of 15 people.

claim: Domaine des Pothiers is a 21-hectare estate in the southernmost Côte Roannaise producing Gamay, Chardonnay, and Pinot Gris wines plus an ancestral-method sparkling rosé.
quote: the estate is 21Ha (52 acres) wide... white wine from the Pinot Gris grape variety, red wine vinified and aged in barrels, an ancestral method rosé sparkling wine

claim: Domaine de la Rochette (Néron family) in Villemontais farms 16 hectares of organic Gamay, Chardonnay, and Pinot Gris on granite soil, with 45-minute cellar visits plus tasting by appointment at €5pp including farmhouse cheeses.
quote: The domain has 16 hectares of vines planted with Gamay (St Romain), Chardonnay, and Pinot Gris varieties that are cultivated on granite soil... Visits consist of two parts: visiting the cellars followed by tasting, lasting approximately 45 minutes, by appointment. The cost is 5 € per person

claim: Domaine de la Bénisson-Dieu in Ambierle sits on the northern edge of the AOC with 2.6 hectares farmed organically and using natural winemaking.
quote: Domaine de La Bénisson-Dieu is located on the northern edge of the Côte Roannaise AOC with 2.6 hectares in production, and is organic with natural winemaking

claim: Summer 'Apéros de la Côte' winegrower encounters (June-September, ~15 domaines) run roughly 1h30 for €18 per person including a 4-wine tasting and local products.
quote: about fifteen winegrowers welcome visitors to discover their domains and wines, with encounters lasting approximately 1h30 and concluding with wine tasting and regional specialties. The visits cost €18 per person

claim: Les Halles Diderot covered market runs Tuesday-Sunday 8am-7pm (Sunday until noon); Roanne also has open-air markets on Tuesday and Friday at Place du Marché, Friday at Place de l'Hôtel de Ville, and Sunday at Place Georges Clemenceau, all 8am-1pm.
quote: Marché des Halles Diderot – mardi, mercredi, jeudi, vendredi, samedi, dimanche de 8h à 19h... Place du marché – mardi, vendredi de 8h à 13h... Place de l'Hôtel de Ville – Friday, 8am-1pm

claim: Mons Fromager-Affineur (the renowned cheesemonger Hervé Mons) has a stall at Les Halles Diderot in Roanne open Tuesday-Sunday, Friday/Saturday 8am-12:30pm and 3-7:30pm.
quote: Tuesday to Thursday: 8:00 AM to 12:30 PM and 3:00 PM to 7:00 PM; Friday and Saturday: 8:00 AM to 12:30 PM and 3:00 PM to 7:30 PM; Sunday: 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM

claim: Maison Mons, based in Saint-Haon-le-Châtel, ages cheeses in a rehabilitated 180-meter former railway tunnel at Ambierle.
quote: A former railway tunnel located in Ambierle, 180 meters long, was rehabilitated into exceptional maturing cellars

claim: Maison Pralus, founded in Roanne in 1948 by Auguste Pralus, created the iconic Praluline brioche with pink pralines in 1955 and now operates as a bean-to-bar chocolatier.
quote: Maison Pralus was founded in 1948 by Auguste Pralus... Praluline®, a brioche with homemade pink pralines created in 1955. François Pralus expanded the chocolate business, becoming one of the few artisans producing chocolate from bean to bar

claim: Pralus operates a flagship boutique inside Les Halles Diderot in Roanne, plus a second Roanne shop on Charles de Gaulle and an additional boutique in Renaison.
quote: Pralus Roanne pastry and chocolate shop, Les Halles Diderot

claim: Saint-Haon-le-Châtel is a fortified medieval village perched above the Roanne plain, one of five 'Village de Caractère en Loire' in the Roannais and a worthwhile detour combined with cellar visits.
quote: Saint-Haon-le-Châtel est l'un des cinq villages labellisés 'Village de Caractère en Loire' du Roannais
